summary: include_role dynamically loads and runs a role as a task; keywords apply only to the include statement, so use apply to affect the role's tasks. It ignores until/retries, doesn't work in handlers, and since 2.21 has a rescuable option for include errors.
questions: How do I run a role conditionally at runtime?
Why don't tags on include_role apply to the role's tasks?
Can I use until/retries with include_role?
How do I make include_role errors rescuable?

answer_card.title: include_role (dynamic role loading)
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.include_role` loads and runs a role dynamically. Use in `tasks`, `pre_tasks`, `post_tasks` or inside a role (not handlers).
- Keywords, loops, conditions apply to the **include itself**. To push `tags`/`become` to the role's tasks, use `apply`.
- `until`/`retries` are ignored.
- Since 2.21, `rescuable` controls whether include errors are task failures or fatal.
